description: Retrieve a parked checkpoint (using claim_ticket) or collect a verified Safe-Room deliverable and Clean-Room Receipt (using buyer_ticket). This call mutates stored state: a burn-after-read checkpoint is deleted on first successful claim, and a successful suite claim consumes the suite. For a council suite, set finalize=true to collect verified deposits already stored, including after a later deposit has quarantined the suite.

finalize.description: For council suites, finalize and merge all verified deposits collected so far.

ticket.description: Signed rc_chk_... or rc_buy_... capability ticket.

name: claim_state
